name: token_zero_mlp_probe_qwen3
_comment: Qwen3-8B counterpart of token_zero_mlp_probe. The training/scoring recipe is unchanged; the pooled depth trajectory spans all 36 captured Qwen post-block layers instead of Llama's 32 (relevant_layers='1-32' would silently drop the top 4 layers for Qwen). expected_total_params is raised by 4 x 1024 (one learned-attention weight row per extra layer) — the guard's job is to catch silent architecture drift, so the 36-layer count is pinned explicitly rather than the guard relaxed.
